**Finding: compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

The APCN 2 Construction & Maintenance Agreement contains no restrictive covenant binding Teleglobe USA Inc.:

- **"compete" hits are false positives** — "Court of competent jurisdiction" (p0272) and "competent tribunal" (p0275).
- **"exclusiv" hit is unrelated** — the sole-and-exclusive-remedy language in the dispute-resolution procedure (p0262).
- Searches for "shall not engage in", "competing products or services", "prohibited from", business/field-of-use/territory restrictions returned nothing responsive; the broad "shall not" sweep surfaced only governance, billing, liability, assignment, confidentiality and termination mechanics.
- Affirmatively the other way: Paragraph 12.20 lets any Party sell IRUs to other Carriers "without any restrictions", Paragraph 12.22 lets any Party make Allocated Capacity available "on any commercial basis without any restrictions", and Subparagraph 17.4 obliges Terminal Parties not to impede Direct Access — all restrictions running against the counterparties, which we do not flag.

The single preferred element (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer) is already met on the face of the document, so the rule is satisfied at the preferred level and no comment or narrowing fallback is needed.
